question: Whose prior recommendation is required to introduce money bills in state legislature?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Governor**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The introduction of money bills in the state legislature requires the prior recommendation of the **Governor**.
 
• According to Article 207 of the Indian Constitution, a money bill cannot be introduced in the Legislative Assembly of a State except on the recommendation of the Governor of the State.
